notes.title: A Tasty Little Update

[*] Added falling death and impact sounds for Goatman

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/9bbcf77cd39e538cf8498bb59ed41bc14039c7dd.jpg[/img]

[*] Console Command 'Set Inventory Size (x,y)' will now work with inventory upgrades (the largest values will be used)

[u][b]Beastform Disguise System[/b][/u]

notes.title: Gloomwood's latest research update adds the most scientific thing of all: headshots
notes.content: Not too long ago, Victorian stealth-em-up Gloomwood received a "research update" that lets players study dissected monsters and then inject their sweet juice directly into your veins for temporary powers. More recently, the early access immsim's latest update has expanded on those research options... Read more.

notes.title: The Research Update
notes.content: [h2]Well would you look at that Doctor! [/h2][h2][/h2][h2]Two Gloomwood updates in two months? [/h2][h2]I'd say [i]you're on a roll![/i][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="QlgQMvYlqsY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]During the last update we introduced [b]research![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]And gave the good doctor the ability to delve into the [i]darkness[/i] a bit...[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150760/view/497192590186120285"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]After slicing and dicing up monster bodies and combining them with jars of [i]god knows what[/i] from around the city, the doctor gained all new abilities from the [b]Crowmen, Goatmen[/b] and [b]Bat Barbers[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Well now, due to [b]popular demand[/b] - you can inject [i]multiple doses[/i] of certain serums like the Bat Barber![/p][previewyoutube="TYx6nszfu0M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/f42cf183774fe3d98e20e801fdac4777ca5e64ae.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also [u][b]made the labels easier to read[/b][/u] on the monster parts you'll need to gather![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/c03921cb4381695569885712eca22172062356c7.png"][/img][/p][p]But more importantly, [b]research will now become available when you first reach the lighthouse[/b], and we've added the ability to research the most common enemy in the game... [/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]The Huntsmen.[/i][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/2818ef62c12c8584adbceb2beafe8afe7284debd.png"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="QGJ02-LtZ0I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/09acb7869cbd8bf1220127e47ce59325f74d9c72.png"][/img][i]Surely you've played Oblivion, doctor...[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This serum will allow you to [b]detect life[/b] through the world, anywhere you can see, as well as blend in with the other Huntsmen, [i]as if you were one of the boys.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][i]But that's not all![/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/329878f5e29aca8e0c98eb7388730b0f57bf3852.png"][/img][/p][p]Research now also grants [b]PASSIVE BONUSES.[/b] (that you keep forever)[/p][p][/p][p]We think you'll especially like the Huntsmen passive ability...[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QHcsPMyFqjI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/dc9374a49f6a8f829ef7932df182fdf8d088d29d.png"][/img][i]But you'll have to research it :)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/b63be70fd308b9ffecb29b9c77223056808c2fd6.png"][/img][/p][p]There's even new ammo [b]just[/b] for you types who like to make things go [i]sploosh:[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/d60769a318cd37c8d8681689bb0de59398ee6bbb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/54aff7f1986977234875139f61878abbec850e87.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to this:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crowman[/b] research will now give you a [b]permanent holstered speed boost[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bat Barber[/b] research will give you a [b]permanent jump height boost[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Goatman[/b] research will give you a [b]permanent damage reduction[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]And don't forget that Goatman [i]serum[/i]... you're going to want it...[/h3][previewyoutube="mjTkFwL8EPU;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="6usTV4CnLw0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img revisiting old areas after reaching certain story points you may find things have indeed changed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Even the weather! (and music)[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]There may be a Goatman stomping around The Fishery ^^[/p][p][/p][p]Or you could see Bat Barbers lurking high within The Caves...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/79dd931227100dc0c2c8ec20df1c1aefe1bbcc95.png"][/img][/p][p]Or you may head back to The Tavern only to find that the Huntsmen are now merrily drinking the night away... notes.title: Gloomwood's research update transforms it from Thief with guns into Dishonored with mutations, letting you inject dissected monster juice into yourself to gain their powers
notes.content: We still don't know the real name of Gloomwood's doctor protagonist, but I'm beginning to suspect it might be 'Jekyll' given what he gets up to in the game's new Research update. notes.title: The Research Update
notes.content:
[h2]Doctor! The old laboratory at the lighthouse is up and running again. 

[i]Time to get to work...[/i][/h2]

[previewyoutube=yVyuABtMlDI;full][/previewyoutube]
Aye, Gloomwood research is finally here, and with it this accursed town will be changed forever... but so will [b]YOU![/b]

Collect body parts of the foul beasts roaming the city with your new BONESAW and bring them back to the lighthouse for... research. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/0a51c7d6e1f8ee6df388217b107dea48dec38caa.jpg[/img]
Once you've done the proper research you'll be able to collect ingredient jars and craft serums that will allow you to [b]TRANSFORM[/b] into these monstrosities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/074ae1f2062b861f48c834b32920f50257d4b6f0.png[/img]
You can currently research and turn into [b]Goatmen[/b] (to become a walking tank), [b]Bat Barbers[/b] (to jump oh so high and fall like a feather) and [b]Crowmen[/b] (to move with super speed)

You can also buy the first suitcase upgrade [b]earlier[/b] now, and the second one after the Hive. (for all those body parts you'll be lugging around)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/67e668dee151d3beb206e3e499b3b09fd9cdf3e2.png[/img]
Gain their powers, use them to get the upper hand on your foes and reach areas previously inaccessible to a mere man... or even [b]blend in[/b] with your new... friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/c31904c1677223dc9fe40dadb7c5323fece83fc1.png[/img]
And as you may have noticed, the doctor's journal has also gotten a complete overhaul for this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/11ab79bb12c951b2393ef855a30356ff0afe288b.png[/img]
Completely diagetic, of course.

[previewyoutube=dUPWXmqY6mw;full][/previewyoutube]
Right now research will unlock when you first get to the mirror dimension, but after the [i]next[/i] update it will unlock a bit later as we'll be adding new enemy spawns (more to research, naturally) as well as passive bonuses, and the ability to research and turn into even [b]more[/b] beasts both big... [i]and small.[/i]

And since this is an immersive sim and you can play it [i]however[/i] you want - research is, of course, [b]completely optional.[/b]

These new features are still being tested so bear with us as we get through this challenging part of the game's development that will hopefully be well worth the time we've invested into it.[/quote]

notes.title: Underport Progress Report
notes.content:
[h3][i]Hello again good doctors.[/i]

Apologies for the lack of announcements over the last few months, but we've been... [b]rather busy.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/474729e3975e21caa868aadc4c54bd2f6500f5d7.png[/img]

notes.title: Gloomwood's next big update delves into the city's dank sewers
notes.content:
One of our favorite early access games is getting a big update soon. As teased during the PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted, Gloomwood is heading down into the Underport.

You can watch the first look at the Underport in the teaser above. From what I can tell, we're in for a dank sewer network hosting slimy pustules and what seems to be a four-legged monster with claws. I hope I'll have saved enough shotgun shells for when we meet face-to-face.

There's not much more to the video than vibes and the promise of an unpleasant encounter, which I guess is what makes it a pretty good teaser. I'm itching to jump back into Gloomwood since I blazed through its opening chapter last year. Since then, the previously locked Tavern was unlocked, as well as the Market area that'll serve as a hub for the main story. There's a shop, new enemies, and as of a more recent Halloween update, flash bombs that give players an option to return to stealth after being spotted by guards. I hope the Underport update will introduce more goodies for my briefcase, too. A new weapon, perhaps?

Associate editor Ted Litchfield dove back into Gloomwood earlier this year when the Market update landed and thought just the areas added since early access launch made a huge difference:

"That diversity of form is something that's really stuck with me about Gloomwood: it's a surprising, varied, 'greatest hits' of all the coolest level ideas that have come out of the immersive sim genre, packaged in Gloomwood's own excellent gothic atmosphere," Ted wrote.

I'll admit I'm still hesitant to start a new save. I prefer not to overfamiliarize myself with immersive sim levels before I have the chance to take in the full game, though if anything is gonna tempt me to reinstall, it's a teeth-grinding sewer journey.

Gloomwood's Underport update is coming "Soon™" according to the teaser. So, let's say 2024 to be safe and hope for sooner?.. Read more.

notes.title: Fire at the Gates
notes.content:
[h2]AH, GOOD DOCTORS.[/h2]

It's been awhile, [i]hasn't it?
[/i]
We've got [u][b]TWO[/b][/u] updates for you today, One you can play [b]NOW[/b] and one you can play [b]SOON™[/b]

The first will cover what we've added to the game [u][b]TODAY[/b][/u] and the second will dig into our progress on [b]Gloomwood's much anticipated [u]Market District[/u].[/b]

But before we can let you in, it's time to.... [b]FIRE AT THE GATES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/f6afb91159967c42f690c9cce743738970a5fce6.png[/img]

[i][h3]Here's what you can investigate today...[/h3][/i]
[u][h3][b]A NEW AREA[/b][/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/0dd181f490a0aa4cbacd8e3d01686a6c84d4ed2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/dbb8a46f1ed488b4fa0e92adfb57d53afd888692.jpg[/img]
The city guard has gotten word of your progress towards the market district - Doctor - [b]and they're not happy about it.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/006df037afe32eaca2728c025a4fc940e6b14851.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/ddff1c5e179a63898a6a9d9542c27c6e4868f97a.jpg[/img]
They've setup a new camp in front of the city gates with new towers, store rooms [b]and one very big cannon to keep you away.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/51a44b816a7e4fd3b6276d08291dc41407c23c98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/bf05ecdcf34a6e32d8cee7e05437e531b2d9f53f.jpg[/img]
But you won't stay away, [i]will you?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/5e31aea97e5c75a83fbeca81bef97aefd550e564.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/56d4f2048b39a14565d1fa44785e9dfef600b73c.jpg[/img]
[i]Find the bits and pieces to fire the cannon, bring down the city gate... and prepare to enter the market.[/i]

Even though that won't be the [b]ONLY[/b] way into the district in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/67e53320b83bbc03cf564ef2e5aa35b152e7c338.jpg[/img]
Luckily you'll have help from:
 
[u][h3][b]A NEW AMMO TYPE[/b][/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/eed10208a2ba309491aacc66454ecfad2edca8fc.png[/img][i](stop calling them water arrows)[/i]

The Undertaker pistol has a new ammo type. We call it The [b]Choke Bolt.[/b]

It can:
[list]
[*]Put out all sources of fire (sneaky)
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/78AF8I1pHpTLrAHlcq/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] Causes enemies to cough/daze briefly (sickly)
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/2rSTKFihHQRJyEfz5B/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] Flinches enemies in mid-attack swing or who are enraged (tricky)
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LHwzTBIgoQ1L8Uul31/giphy.gif[/img]
[/list]Also the [b]slug[/b] ammo can now break any type of electrical light and [b]incendiary[/b] ammo can now re-ignite any source of fire that was doused or burnt out :)

But that's not all today, we've got...

[u][h3][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h3][/u]
Such as an (optional) [b]action log[/b] that will tell you what keys and notes you've picked up, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/6a826880b30866d6872724957652f7086eca7b4d.jpg[/img]
And the much requested ability to [b]drop heavy items on enemies heads[/b] to [i]end their days.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/70x7PPITKppX1zUeax/giphy.gif[/img]
[i](this one was fun)[/i]

We've also got:

[h3][u][b]NEW SECRETS[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/5753d910838721dbe36805ecf3c97ea67bc56d06.jpg[/img][i]Plus added destructible wall spots (notated with a crack) ^[/i]

[u][h3][b]NEW OPTIONS[/b][/h3][/u]
Such as the ability to select new save slots at phonographs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/4292c556670ee82872a2914e3e487a6d95f7e498.jpg[/img]
The developer console, light flares and yes *Quicksaving* are a [b]toggle[/b] in the gameplay options now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/b057f7507d223dcfeff0180703a881d85ec95917.jpg[/img]
There's also...

[h3]Improved enemy AI, and of course - [b]lots of new guard conversations[/b][/h3]
[i](thanks Gianni)[/i]

[i]Performance has also been improved and of course many bugs have been fixed.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/2f4da2db9c86c6be9dbeca8e1ff31d113d1af42f.png[/img]
We like to think we've been adding these areas organically so it feels like the world of Gloomwood is growing for you [i]as we develop it.[/i] 

New camps are being set up. New secrets are being uncovered. [b]But your journey is just beginning.[/b]

NOW, that's what we've done - [i]here's what's to come.[/i]

[h3]We will finally be letting you into Gloomwood's market District on [b]July 21st.[/b][/h3]
[i]Just in time for the Steam Stealth Fest on the 24th.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/3dab44e84de5bd7c228101512fc9212ec0ce6b71.png[/img]
But that's not all the news we bring.

In that screenshot you may see a shop? Yes - [b]that's the merchant's shop[/b] - and he [b]is[/b] inside. 

No longer hiding in the shadows - now that you've made it this far.

Once inside he's got [b]A LOT[/b] to say [i](thanks to the incomparable Stephan Weyte)[/i] and also much to buy and sell, good doctor.

Have a look...

[previewyoutube=T8_GiVpvBI4;full][/previewyoutube]
As you can see, in typical [i]Gloomwood[/i] fashion - [b]everything done in the shop will be diegetic.[/b] 

There are no menus, no UI, [i]everything is done immersively and in-world.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/04edaeb5bd0bf8fded146cc4f31bdaeccb445aa5.png[/img]
[b]AND YES THIS WAS ALL VERY HARD TO DO THANK YOU.[/b]

Come and go as you please, buy and sell as you must - [i]The Emerald Eye[/i] is a safe haven for you, Doctor. 

And on higher difficulties, finding treasures and trinkets to sell to the merchant for health and ammunition may just be the difference between life or death in [i]Gloomwood.[/i]

Speaking of death - you may notice something else menacing in that screenshot above.

[h3][u][b]A NEW ENEMY[/b][/u][/h3]

[previewyoutube=NfIK2vWrQi8;full][/previewyoutube]
Yes, along with Huntsmen, Hounds, and Crowmen in the sewers - you'll now have to deal with the Bat Barbers of Gloomwood as you make your way through the market district, doctor.

But who doesn't fancy a good [b]CUT[/b] every now and then, hmm?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/c665a884f247f62f9b88cbc9ba748b83743a1f24.jpg[/img]
Thank you for your patience as we work on this incredibly complex and immersive experience for you.

And we hope as always that you enjoy.

We know there are some who say our development goes not fast enough for their liking, but know this... 

[b]WE WILL NEVER SACRIFICE QUALITY FOR TIME.[/b]

[i]And we hope you appreciate that.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150760/Gloomwood/

For more frequent updates please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NewBlood]Twitter[/url] and Subscribe to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TafferKing451]Dillon on YouTube[/url]

[h3]Foolish doctors.[i] You dare tempt fate yet again?[/i]

The [i]Slaughtered Goat Tavern[/i] is [b]NOW AVAILABLE[/b] for you to enter.

If you dare...[/h3]

[previewyoutube=EJhcZ66zFgI;full][/previewyoutube]
Indeed, this latest update to adds the much anticipated tavern level to the cliffs of [i]Gloomwood[/i].

And as you can see, it's much more than just a rotten old building to explore. Inside is the deadliest foe you've yet to encounter. [i]And the son of a bitch has the key to get out. [/i]

Steal it from him, take it off his corpse, turn tail and ignore the tavern all together. [b]It matters not.[/b] You'll never survive the night. Not on Blood Moon anyway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/703e4789b646864599d324b727f0a3636b6141bc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/ef016764e8b76535bfb2921ad77cecf7f3a929eb.png[/img]

Since our Early Access launch just a short [i]4 months ago[/i] we've been hard at work taking your feedback and applying it directly to the game's development. And this last update for the year is a tribute to that.

notes.title: Thank You... Now What's Next.
notes.content:
Hello, good doctors of Gloomwood.

[i]Quite a week it's been, aye?[/i]

Since releasing Gloomwood into Early Access, we are thrilled to report that it has become New Blood's fastest selling title EVER. Eclipsing the launches of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/519860/DUSK/]DUSK[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/]AMID EVIL[/url], and even the mighty [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229490/ULTRAKILL/]ULTRAKILL[/url].

Turns out the immersive sim genre isn't so [b]CURSED[/b] after all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/7e586d4a816c494014504fa8b4abe026f62ce93e.png[/img]

But while we'd love to celebrate,[i] this is no time to rest...[/i]

We've been gathering your feedback from everywhere you've spilled it, and [b]we've heard what you want from Gloomwood.[/b]

This is [b]Early Access[/b] after all, and if you're familiar with the way we do things around here, then you'll know that we're committed to building our games [b]WITH[/b] you, the players. Because that's how you make better games. [i]Isn't it?![/i]

You've told us you want [b]MORE CONTENT[/b] and [b]MORE DIFFICULTY OPTIONS. [/b]

[i]And we're going to give it to you.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/ac89f3d051ae019aa81456ea58444fe1f8ada49e.jpg[/img]

Today we're releasing a small update that adds some balance tweaks and other goodies...

[b]GENERAL[/b]

- Increased stealth benefit from Lean action as long as body is obscured
- Tweaked AI vertical vision to reduce spotting players directly above
- Increased the size of safes to allow players to hide in them 
- Added a certain special Looking Glass-style code for safes 
- Adjusted ammunition/supplies on all difficulties 

[b]DIFFICULTY: FULL MOON[/b]

- Incoming player damage set to 150%
- AI combat movement speed increased to 120%
- AI attack speed increased to 120%
- AI projectile speed  increased to 120%
- AI sight angle modifier increased to 110%
- AI sight range modifier increased to 110%
- AI hearing radius modifier increased to 120%

- Increased speed of axe windup and recovery 
- Receives a significant movement speed boost when in close proximity to their target

[b]ENEMY: RIFLE HUNTSMAN[/b]

-Increased maximum rifle shooting distance to 30 meters (from 15)

[b]ENEMY: FISHDOG[/b]

- Bite damage increased to 15-18 (up from 10-12)
- Recieves a movement speed boost when in close proximity to the target 
- 'Bark' sound can now be heard from further away (including from other Fishdogs)

[b]NEW ENEMY VARIANT: ARMORED HUNTSMAN[/b]

- Does not receive backstab damage from the Canesword
- Immune to physical damage in the torso/head region and resistant to physical damage elsewhere
- Resistant to bullet damage in the torso/head region 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/032df25d13933a6ce2615c98bc046bcac6852b4a.png[/img]

[b]LEVEL: FISHERY[/b]

- Added inventory manual note that documents all special inventory actions 
- Added additional secret area

[b]LEVEL: MINES[/b]

- Added additional Fishdogs on the higher difficulties
- Added Armored Huntsmen on the higher difficulties 

[b]LEVEL: LIGHTHOUSE[/b]

- Tweaked tavern exterior and cellar geometry and added note to improve flow and lore
- Tweaked AI patrols to feel a bit more natural
- Added Armored Huntsmen 

[b]BUGS[/b]

- Fixed Brightness menu slider arrows not working correctly 
- Fixed issue where Brightness menu contrast images would not factoring base contrast correctly when first opening
- Fixed issue where AI would fail to load task queue correctly and walk in place on load 
- Fixed issue where AI would cancel search unexpectedly 
- Fixed save/load issue with AI failing to return to leash
- Fixed issue where AI conversations would not resume correctly when loading a save
- Fixed issue where Fishdog bark/howl teasers would continue to play after they are disabled
- Fixed key for padlock along Lighthouse coastal path not having correct id/description tags
- Fixed issue where tutorial prompts would appear even with tutorials turned off
- Improved handling of broken/corrupt user.ini parsing 
- Set default text culture to Invariant Culture to help prevent non-English OS issues 
- Fixed various null refs and potential crashes

[h3]But that's not all...[/h3]

You asked for it, [b]so you're gonna get it[/b]. And probably [i]sooner than you think.[/i]

[b]BLOOD MOON[/b] difficulty will feature harder (and more armored) enemies, more alert AI, [b]limited saves[/b] and more tweaks to make your experience in the [i]accursed [/i]town of Gloomwood... just that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/eaf8efc9de85fa00f6c8bf95d7443297ab70d86c.png[/img]

But we haven't forgotten the people that want more [i]lenient[/i] options as well. So SOON we'll also be working on [b]Crescent Moon[/b] difficulty and [b]Lunacy (custom)[/b] Difficulty which will allow for [b]QUICKSAVING[/b] plus easier enemy encounters as well as [i]MORE[/i] health and ammo to find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871809/35b5939d50fa9adab2ceb083b149b3478fb6000f.png[/img]

But tweaking the balance in a stealth game like Gloomwood is understandably hard for a small team like ours, so we're going to need [b]YOUR HELP.[/b]

We're going to be opening up a [b]Public Testing Branch[/b] for Gloomwood that will allow you to test these difficulty changes [u]before[/u] they go live in order to give us feedback and let us know if we're doing it right!

We hope you'll use this opportunity to help us continue to make Gloomwood the best experience it can be for players of [b]ALL[/b] skill levels.

[previewyoutube=snSNCQLqZto;full][/previewyoutube]
We'll see you [b]SOON™[/b] doctors.
